noon_scope_spec.coverage_note: noon is evidenced as a UAE/KSA/Egypt shopping, grocery, food, send, and delivery platform. This pass uses UAE Atlas waterfront geometry only; KSA and Egypt stay narrative/future scope until local Atlas overlap and use cases are grounded.

hold_markets: Bahrain for Noon-specific display unless locally validated

draft_partner_page_shape.hero: Waterfront quick-commerce, concierge transfer, and experience logistics for the UAE’s densest marina, resort, and event districts.
draft_partner_page_shape.why_now: UAE waterfront districts concentrate high-value residents, visitors, restaurants, hotels, and events, while Noon already aggregates commerce, food, grocery, send, and fast-delivery demand in one app surface.
draft_partner_page_shape.multimodal_fit: Navier operates as the marine leg inside Noon’s same-day / minutes / send / experience layer, not as a standalone consumer ferry brand.
